complexity.notes: Membership test `bracket in ["(", "{", "["]` rebuilds a list on every iteration; a module-level set constant or a closing-to-opening dict mapping would be cleaner and slightly faster. The elif chain with pop() inside conditions is correct but hard to read; a dict lookup plus a single pop-and-compare would be more idiomatic.
complexity.summary: Iterates through the string using a stack: pushes opening brackets, and on each closing bracket pops the top and verifies it is the matching opener. Returns true only if every close matches and the stack is empty at the end.
